required_outcomes: Records the landlord's decision as his own contractor (Dev Malik, Hale Property Services) and does not instruct an agency contractor.

Tells the landlord that the swap had already happened on 23 Dec, before his email; his machine is in garage 15, Rowan's machine is working; and Rowan is away 27 Dec to 10 Jan, so Monday 28th cannot go ahead as planned (bank holiday, office closed so the spare garage key cannot be released, tenant away).
Offers workable options: a garage-only visit from Tue 29 Dec once Rowan confirms his agreement in writing and the key is released to the named engineer, or a visit after Rowan returns on 11 Jan.
Asks Rowan to confirm in writing (email) that he agrees to garage-only access while away, and tells him what the landlord plans.
acceptable_alternatives: Proposing only a visit after 11 Jan and not offering access while Rowan is away.
Offering the landlord to have isolation valves fitted (landlord's work, his approval needed), given his concern about a machine plumbed in without valves.
positive_behaviours: Does not scold Rowan for the swap; passes on the landlord's concern about the valves factually.
Sets a follow-up for the landlord's answer on the new date.
red_flags: Confirms Monday 28 Dec to the landlord or his engineer as if access were arranged.
Releases the garage key or arranges access on the strength of the phone call alone, without written agreement.
prohibited_actions: Instructing an agency contractor when the landlord is sending his own.
Escalating a scheduling conflict the case worker can resolve.
critical_failures: Arranges entry while the tenant is away without his written agreement.
